statement_summary: One group program aligned to CSF 2.0 that meets each contracting entity's federal obligations
Group CISO accountable; Affirming Official designated per contracting entity
Annual SP 800-30 risk analysis per division with roll-up to group
Risk acceptance authority; life-safety and federal-eligibility High risks must be treated
Division supplements may not weaken group policy; re-align within 90 days; annual attestation
Divisions document common control inheritance annually
Sanctions documented
Security review and flowdowns for third parties; CMMC status check before award
Annual independent assessment; affirmations only on independently tested evidence
Six-year retention of security documentation and CMMC artifacts
AI systems registered and approved under the Group AI Standard
Building and installed systems segmented, accessed through PAM, monitored, default credentials changed
regulatory_driver: N53-R04 (PCI DSS Requirement 1, parking); group building systems standard

statement_summary: Section 889: no covered equipment; group approved-manufacturer list; documented reasonable inquiry
Bank and remittance changes only in the payment factory with call-back and second approver
Unique identities; no shared accounts
Role-based least privilege; CUI access approved by the federal practice leader
MFA for all workforce; phishing-resistant for administrators, finance, project executives, SAM administrators
Service accounts owned, governed, workload identity or 90-day rotation
Access disabled within 4 hours of termination
Privileged access just in time through PAM
External PDPP accounts expire at closeout and after 90 days inactive; MFA for owner approvers and subcontractor administrators
Vendor and integrator access only through group PAM; no persistent tunnels
TSSI client credentials in per-client partitions; rotated at handover and on technician departure
No more than 3 SAM Entity Administrators per entity; monthly EFT reconciliation
Physical access, visitor escort, and visitor logs where FCI or CUI is handled, including trailers
Report suspected incidents to the SOC within 1 hour
One group severity scale and playbooks
DoD report within 72 hours; malware to DC3; images kept 90 days; A&E gives report number to the prime
Counsel maintains the notification matrix and approves every notice
regulatory_driver: State breach notification laws (Fla. Stat. 501.171 worked example)

statement_summary: Severity 1 and large payment fraud escalated to the disclosure committee within 24 hours
Covered equipment reported within 1 business day; mitigation within 10 business days
CMMC requirements restored and re-assessed after an incident before relying on the status
Payment recall and IC3 complaint at once; freeze bank changes
regulatory_driver: N23-R01 (FAR 52.232-27(c) payment duties on federal jobs)

statement_summary: Annual cross-division exercise with DoD reporting and a materiality decision
CUI only in the enclave
Field access to CUI only through enclave desktops; no exports; plots marked
FCI only on Level 1 scope systems or approved external systems
Encryption at rest and in transit; FIPS-validated in the enclave
Certified payrolls only through the PDPP intake with masked Social Security numbers
Client facility security details shared only with approved users
Backups held separately and restore-tested
Media sanitized or destroyed with a record
No FCI, CUI, Restricted, or Confidential data in unapproved AI tools; no AI tool approved for CUI
Public posting reviewed; no FCI, CUI, or client security details
Annual security awareness training including business email compromise; quarterly phishing exercises
CUI handling training before access for anyone who handles CUI
Never act on an emailed bank change
FCI, CUI, and Restricted data only on managed devices and approved services
Approved generative AI tools only; never enter FCI, CUI, bid pricing, or personal information into public AI
